accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: The position NFT's token account, which the liquidity authority must already hold.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the DAO's accounts and the pool's creation. Chooses nothing.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Only whoever holds the token's mint may open its DAO, and hands the mint to it in
the same instruction. A DAO that governs a token someone else can still mint governs
nothing; and a mint handed to the DAO's address first could be claimed by anyone
who opened the DAO before its owner did.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The DAO's DAMM v2 pool, whose price the markets open at.

accounts.name: creator_token
docs: Where the creator's stake comes from.

accounts.name: stake_escrow
docs: Holds the stake until the proposal is decided.

types.name: Action
docs: Something a proposal option does if it wins. Deliberately a closed list: an option
that could run arbitrary instructions would be one nobody can price.

types.name: DAOAccount
docs: One DAO per token, governed by futarchy over its liquidity pool.
Upstream kept the treasury and the mint authority in Squads multisigs whose members
were the protocol's own keys, and ran a passing proposal's outcome by hand. Here both
are PDAs of this program: the only instructions that sign for them are
`execute_transfer` and `execute_mint`, and those only run an action attached to the
option that won.
Seeds: [DAO_SEED, token_mint]

fields.name: admin
docs: Creates proposals. Holds no power over the treasury or the mint.

fields.name: liquidity_authority
docs: Holds the position NFT, so only this program can move the pool's liquidity.

fields.name: position
docs: The DAMM v2 position whose liquidity seeds proposals. Default until attached.

fields.name: withdrawal_bps
docs: Share of the position's unlocked liquidity each proposal's markets are seeded with.

fields.name: active_proposal
docs: The proposal whose markets hold the liquidity right now, or default. One at a time,
so liquidity on its way into a proposal cannot be pushed back into the pool.

fields.name: price_checkpoint
docs: The pool's square-root price as `record_price` last saw it, and when. Moving the
DAO's liquidity, or opening a market, needs the pool to still be near a price that
held at least a minute ago: see `price_guard.rs`.

fields.name: price_anchor
docs: Where the checkpoint stood when its current window opened, and when: within a
window it moves `MAX_CHECKPOINT_DRIFT_BPS` from there at most, whoever records.

fields.name: pending_return
docs: Set when a proposal's liquidity comes home, cleared when it is back in the pool. No
proposal may take liquidity out in between, or each would take a share of what was
left in the pool while the rest sat outside it, and the position would melt away.

types.name: GovernanceConfig
docs: The rules every proposal of a DAO runs under, fixed when the DAO opens.
Upstream let each proposal's creator pick its own length, TWAP bounds and pass margin,
which was harmless while only the protocol's admin could propose. Anyone can propose
here, so none of it is theirs to choose: a one-minute market, or a TWAP that cannot
move, would decide a vote before anyone could trade it.

fields.name: proposal_length_minutes
docs: How long a proposal's markets trade, in minutes.

fields.name: warmup_seconds
docs: Seconds at the start of a proposal during which the TWAP does not count.

fields.name: market_bias_bps
docs: How far above the status quo's TWAP an option must finish to win, in basis points.

fields.name: max_observation_change_bps
docs: How far the TWAP's observation may move per update, in basis points of the price the
market opened at.

fields.name: market_fee_bps
docs: The conditional markets' trading fee, in basis points.

fields.name: proposal_stake
docs: DAO tokens a proposer locks until the proposal is decided. Zero for none.

fields.name: max_transfer_bps
docs: The most one `Transfer` action may take, in basis points of what the treasury holds
of that token when it runs. A market worth a few thousand dollars must not be able
to hand over everything in one vote.

fields.name: max_mint_bps
docs: The most one `MintTo` action may issue, in basis points of the supply when it runs.

fields.name: execution_delay_seconds
docs: Seconds between a proposal's decision and its actions becoming executable: time for
holders who disagree to leave before a hostile outcome lands.

fields.name: execution_window_seconds
docs: Seconds after that during which the actions may run. Past it they never can: an
old decision must not be executable against a treasury that has moved on.

fields.name: failed_stake_slash_bps
docs: Share of the stake kept by the treasury when the market turns a proposal down, in
basis points. Proposing costs something only if it can cost something.

types.name: ModeratorAccount
docs: Seeds: [MODERATOR_SEED, base_mint]

types.name: OptionActions
docs: The actions attached to one option of one proposal.
Written only while the proposal is in `Setup`, so they are fixed before a single trade:
the market prices exactly what will run. Option 0 is the status quo and never has any.
Seeds: [ACTIONS_SEED, proposal, option_index]

fields.name: executed
docs: Bit i is set once action i has run. Each runs at most once.

types.name: PoolFeesStruct
docs: Information regarding fee charges
trading_fee = amount * trade_fee_numerator / denominator
protocol_fee = trading_fee * protocol_fee_percentage / 100
referral_fee = protocol_fee * referral_percentage / 100

types.name: ProposalAccount
docs: Seeds: [PROPOSAL_SEED, moderator.key(), &id.to_le_bytes()]

fields.name: authority
docs: Who opened the raise.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: The token being sold. Its launch supply is minted into `base_vault` when the raise
opens; the mint authority passes to `pool_operator` if the raise succeeds.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: What backers pay in. USDC in production; any 6-decimal mint in tests.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives `goal - quote_to_pool` when the raise succeeds.

fields.name: pool_operator
docs: Receives `quote_to_pool` and `tokens_for_pool` to open the liquidity pool, and the
mint authority to hand to the DAO. The only account that can open claims early.

fields.name: goal
docs: The amount raised, exactly: oversubscription is refunded, not kept.

fields.name: claim_delay_seconds
docs: How long after `ends_at` a raise that met its goal may wait to become a DAO. Past
it, `settle` marks it failed and everyone takes their commitment back.

fields.name: dao_commitment
docs: The DAO it opens on success, committed to at creation: see `InitializeRaiseArgs`.

types.name: RewardInfo
docs: Stores the state relevant for tracking liquidity mining rewards

constants.name: CHECKPOINT_MAX_AGE
docs: The pool price a DAO's liquidity moves at must be within `MAX_PRICE_MOVE_BPS` of a
checkpoint updated in the last `CHECKPOINT_MAX_AGE` seconds. The checkpoint itself
follows the pool slowly: at most once per `CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL`, and by at most
`MAX_CHECKPOINT_STEP_BPS` each time, and by at most `MAX_CHECKPOINT_DRIFT_BPS` in any
`CHECKPOINT_WINDOW` (see price_guard.rs).

constants.name: LFOWN_MAX_OPTIONS
docs: LFOwn fork: a proposal is a yes or a no. The program could hold six options, but every
screen that shows a proposal, and every trader reading one, deals in two: a third
option nobody looks at is where a hostile action would hide.

constants.name: LIQUIDITY_SEED
docs: Seeds: [LIQUIDITY_SEED, dao]. Owns the DAO's DAMM v2 position and every token on its
way between that pool and a proposal's markets.

constants.name: MAX_ACTIONS
docs: Actions one option can carry. Kept small: every action is something a trader has to
read and price before the market opens.

constants.name: MAX_WITHDRAWAL_BPS
docs: The most of a position's liquidity one proposal may take into its markets. Never all
of it: the pool keeps trading while a proposal runs.

constants.name: MINT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Seeds: [MINT_AUTHORITY_SEED, dao]. The DAO token's mint authority.

constants.name: MIN_PROPOSAL_MINUTES
docs: Bounds on a DAO's proposal length: long enough that a market can form, short enough
that the DAO's liquidity is not away from its pool for weeks.

constants.name: POSITION_NFT_SEED
docs: Seeds: [POSITION_NFT_SEED, dao]. The mint of a bootstrapped pool's position NFT.

constants.name: PROTOCOL_FEE_SHARE_BPS
docs: LFOwn's share of the fees a DAO's pool position earns, in basis points. The rest goes
to the DAO's treasury.

constants.name: STAKE_SEED
docs: Seeds: [STAKE_SEED, proposal]. The token account holding a proposer's stake.

constants.name: TREASURY_SEED
docs: Seeds: [TREASURY_SEED, dao]. Owns the DAO's token accounts.
